scientific_integrity: Analytic infinite-dimensional proof supplied; finite numerical and exact-arithmetic tests are supplementary and are not a substitute for proof. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns full square complex Toeplitz and Hankel matrix spaces with their unweighted Frobenius Hilbert norm. Its stability bound requires each summand perpendicular to the two-dimensional intersection. The complete finite-n angle spectrum is not given, and independent correctness or publication priority has not been verified.
title: Reciprocal-integer principal-angle law for finite Toeplitz and Hankel matrix spaces
